author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia has announced a robotics research laboratory in Singapore with university partners. The lab will focus on simulating warehouse robots before they are deployed in physical facilities.

The first research program is scheduled to begin in January 2027. Participating teams will use Nvidia computing systems to evaluate navigation and object-handling methods.
headline: Nvidia Announces Singapore Robotics Research Lab With University Partners
summary: Nvidia plans a Singapore laboratory focused on robot simulation, with its first research program scheduled for January 2027.
